checks.explanation: Whether the second Trump term is judged 'successful' is a subjective, ongoing assessment that can't be conclusively resolved this early in the term.
Confirmed: Donald Trump won the November 2024 presidential election.
With unified Republican control of Congress in 2025, the administration secured its major budgetary and appropriations priorities, including the reconciliation-passed 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act.'

ICE deportations, including of individuals with criminal records, ramped up substantially in 2025-2026, but no independently verified figure confirms the specific claim of one million criminal-migrant removals as the administration's starting point.
Illegal border crossings dropped dramatically to historic lows under the Trump administration in 2025, consistent with the prediction.

US GDP growth has not gained the predicted additional 150-300 basis points from deregulation; growth has remained in the roughly 2-4% range through 2025-2026 rather than showing that scale of structural acceleration.
